description:
Nutrilio Local backup & restore now adds native Export backup file and Import backup file rows to the Backup screen (above Restore Backup) instead of a button. Both drive Nutrilios built-in local file backup/restore (all entries, images and settings to a portable .nutrilio ZIP; restore from a picked file; no Google account or premium). Plus existing SonyLIV, Threads and Arrow Puzzle patches.

Verified: morphe-cli applies; baksmali confirms both injections. Row rendering not device-verified.
